"""The 11 mindmap workflow tools are registered next to the existing work tools."""

from mem_mcp.main import native_tool_classes
from mem_mcp.mcp.registry import ToolRegistry

NEW_TOOLS = {
    "mindmap_workflow_create",
    "mindmap_workflow_get",
    "mindmap_workflow_activate",
    "mindmap_workflow_propose_move",
    "mindmap_workflow_signoff",
    "mindmap_workflow_cancel_move",
    "mindmap_workflow_remap",
    "mindmap_work_list",
    "mindmap_work_get",
    "mindmap_work_history",
    "mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs",
}
EXISTING_WORK_TOOLS = {
    "mindmap_work_mark",
    "mindmap_work_set_status",
    "mindmap_work_set_kind",
    "mindmap_work_assign",
}


def _registry() -> ToolRegistry:
    registry = ToolRegistry()
    for tool_cls in native_tool_classes():
        registry.register(tool_cls)
    return registry


def test_new_workflow_tools_registered() -> None:
    names = set(_registry().names())
    assert NEW_TOOLS <= names
    assert EXISTING_WORK_TOOLS <= names


def test_tool_classes_have_unique_names() -> None:
    names = [c.name for c in native_tool_classes()]
    assert len(names) == len(set(names))
E
